Using hyperpowers:using-hyperpowers — the ladder puts this at rung 1, so I'm flagging before editing.

The change itself is one line in `config.js:3`: `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30` → `480`.

The consequence beyond that line: session lifetime is security posture. Going 30m → 8h means a stolen session token, an unattended logged-in browser, or a hijacked session stays valid for a full working day instead of half an hour — a 16x widening of the window in which a compromised session can be used. `server.js:2` confirms this value is what actually expires sessions, so nothing else mitigates it.

That may well be exactly what you want (long-lived internal tool, dev convenience, reducing re-login friction). I just need the explicit yes before making it.

Confirm and I'll change the value — nothing else.
hmm, good point — ok, make it 2 hours instead
